# FLX-7005: accuracy document does not have the required shape

**Family:** calibration (the 7000 band)

A PredictionRecord or ObservedReadout handed to the CLI is absent, is not JSON, is missing a required field, carries a value of the wrong type, or names a value outside a closed set. Every problem found is reported together, with the legal values of each closed set, so the document can be fixed in one pass rather than one field per run. The field list is also in the flag's own --help.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-7005
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
